content.title: Home Depot Stock Edges Lower After Company Provides Muted Outlook
content.summary: Home Depot shares fell 1.3% after the company forecast lower-than-expected sales growth for next year amid an extended downturn in home-improvement activity.  Home Depot predicted same-store sales for fiscal 2026 to grow in the range of flat to 2%, also below analysts’ expectations.  Economic uncertainty and a stalled housing market have made homeowners more cautious about taking on big renovation projects.
